name: Overwork
overview: Scripture teaches that while God grants the ability to gain wealth, our efforts apart from Him are ultimately in vain, as seen in Deuteronomy 8:18 and Psalms 127:1. Jesus warns against storing earthly treasures that perish and calls believers to prioritize heavenly riches through generosity and following Him (Matthew 6:19; 19:21). Additionally, life’s true value is not measured by material abundance, and rest is ordained for our benefit, reminding us that overwork neglects the purpose of God's design (Luke 12:15; Mark 2:27).
